entities.summary: Eastern Lunda Kingdom, a political institution in Zambia during Pre-Colonial Kingdoms and Chiefdoms (1700–1899). Grew from Bemba Kingdom and Lozi Kingdom. Led to the emergence of Lunda-Kazembe Kingdom.
